detail.reason: Reviewed and reaffirmed against newly integrated coarse-graining and finite-resolution literature.

detail.summary: This cycle advances the analysis of causal memory and dissipation bounds by synthesizing source-backed evidence regarding finite-resolution system descriptions, environmental redundancy, and thermodynamic costs.
